name: derm
description: derm's own plugins: claude plugin marketplace add aetiusgular/derm (or a clone's path), then claude plugin install derm@derm. The plugin id is derm@derm, as packages/derm-claude-plugin/managed-settings.fragment.json expects.

plugins.name: derm
plugins.description: derm policy gate for Claude Code: PreToolUse checks every tool call against ~/.derm/policy.json and blocks when the hook fails; PostToolUse redacts and records.
